## What changed

Describe the change and who it helps. Link the issue it closes, for example "Closes #123".

## How you tested it

List the commands you ran and what they showed, for example `cd mcp && npm test`, or
`npm run build && npm run verify` for the website. Add any browser, accessibility or manual checks.

## Checklist

- [ ] A bug fix or behaviour change comes with a test that fails without it.
- [ ] Any number added to a page or README comes from a file the repository can regenerate.
- [ ] Quantitative claims are linked to reproducible evidence.
- [ ] Paper-trading and risk disclosures remain accurate.
- [ ] No credentials, API keys, subscriber data, licensed data, or proprietary inputs are included.

## Credit

How should we credit you in the contributors list and changelog: your name, your GitHub handle, or
no public credit? If this is a research contribution, say so for `CITATION.cff`. See
[How credit works](https://github.com/arhancanli/canlicapital/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#how-credit-works).
